title: video author output
description: The result part of the preview video: markup, CSS and timeline code that video-build.mjs inserts into assets/video/frame.html.

markup.description: HTML placed inside #result. No script, style, link, iframe or media tags.

css.description: CSS for the markup. Scope every selector under #result.

timeline_js.description: Body of function (tl, R): tl.set / tl.to / tl.fromTo calls between R.start and R.end.
